PRINT AT 100% / ACTUAL SIZE
DISABLE FIT TO PAGE / shrink to fit / scale to fit. Measure the ruler before use: 0 to 100 must read 100.0 mm and the cross-check bar 50.0 mm (±0.5). If either is off, do not use the sheet: reprint.
CHECK SHEET. The rings are placed by tracing the pads (chapter G). Lay this sheet on each ALEX top corner: the traced circle must sit on the ⌀50 circle, centred 5 cm in from both edges. It is a drilling template only for the optional ALEX feet, on the bottom corners.
The ring's own holes are at 90 / 210 / 330° in its file; the template drills 45 / 165 / 285°. The ring is round and is turned so its holes meet the pilots. ALEX top panel 15.9 mm (5/8 in), measured 23 Oct 2026: the #6 × 5/8 in screws go 13.4 mm in and leave 2.5 mm.
